title: Idle Clicker Games for Android Explained, With an Example
subtitle: What makes the genre work, shown through one game.
description: Idle clicker games for Android explained: tapping, passive income, prestige resets and offline progress, shown with Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker as an example.
card: What idle clicker games are, why prestige resets matter, and how Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker uses the genre formula.

faq.q: What is an idle clicker game?
faq.a: An idle clicker, or incremental game, lets you tap to earn, spend on things that earn automatically, and keep growing while you are away. Resets for permanent multipliers keep the long game interesting.

faq.q: Is Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker real cryptocurrency?
faq.a: No. It is a game and the coins are only a score. There is no wallet, nothing can be withdrawn and no real money or crypto is earned by playing.

faq.q: Which languages does Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker support?
faq.a: It supports 12 languages: English, Dutch, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Russian, Italian and Turkish. You can switch the language in the settings at any time, and the text is translated throughout the game.
